options.content: Reports on network times, number of requests by categories, status codes, and location ID's.

panels.title: All data within this dashboard is from public endpoints of various domains

panels.description: Number of request group by HTTP Status Code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  toString(httpCode),
  ${cnt_all} as http
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, httpCode
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=HTTP codes; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: HTTP codes

panels.description: Number of requests per Context Category.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  toString(contextCategory),
${cnt_all} AS Category
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, contextCategory
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Categories; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Categories

panels.description: Shows the sum of the averages of tlsHandshake, connect, and dns times.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  ${avg_tls_handshake_time} + ${avg_tcp_connect_time} + ${avg_dns_lookup_time} AS "Networking Time"
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total networking time (DNS + TCP + SSL); du=${__user.login}'
